Table with colspan attribute in a header cell

```python title="Python"

def main() -> None:
    html = '<table><thead><tr><th colspan="2">Full Name</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>John</td><td>Doe</td></tr></tbody></table>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
